# Repository security configuration

Enable private vulnerability reporting, secret scanning with push protection, Dependabot alerts and security updates, code scanning, and immutable releases in repository settings before public release. The canonical reporting policy is [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

GitHub Free does not expose every protection for private repositories. Branch protection/rulesets, secret-scanning push protection, protected-environment reviewers, and immutable releases are release blockers until the account plan or repository visibility supports them.
